ai_review.summary: Good‑quality audience tape captures a standout Space → The Wheel transition.
ai_review.review: The audience recording is praised for its clear transfer and edit, delivering solid sound despite the crowd ambience. Reviewers highlight a very nice segue from Space into The Wheel as a high point of the show.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one 4‑star review is available; it praises both the audience tape quality and a strong Space→Wheel performance, indicating an overall positive impression of show and recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience tape with clear capture; transfer and edit by Bob Wagner and Charlie Miller noted as well‑done, though typical crowd ambience remains.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth segue from Space into The Wheel highlighted as a key moment.
